moduleContract: Full pinned Node22 export-name record. Both specifier aliases bind the same actual default object/functions; process global equals default. Explicit partial behavior and limitations follow.

node:url.callablePolicy: Supported finite methods use real guest algorithms/native providers. Enumerated unsupported callables throw own coded ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED on call or construction; no host builtin adapters.
deviations: Actual existing native WHATWG URL/URLSearchParams are retained and global constructors share identity. Missing URL.canParse is implemented using that same constructor, preserving input conversion exceptions.

POSIX guest file URL conversion supports percent/Unicode/encoded-slash/host checks. windows:true is an explicit unsupported operation; fileURLToPath never opens a path. Relative pathToFileURL uses deployed FS cwd.

Legacy format supports URL-shaped objects and real querystring.stringify. String input requires deferred legacy parsing and refuses. Nonstring legacy fields and Unicode-domain URL formatting options are a bounded refusal.

Legacy Url/parse/resolve/resolveObject/domainToASCII/domainToUnicode/urlToHttpOptions remain named explicit throwing functions. No universal Proxy/stub module or private export is placed in the public Node manifest.
